note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The dependent state is a plain text comparison of the entry's wording with the page (written there or not); it says nothing about truth, admissibility or legal relevance.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The first card entry is a copy of ¶3 ('Party B signed the delivery note on Day 4.'). Its wording is replaced by a paraphrase ('Party B received the goods on Day 4.') that is not written on the page: the copied highlight goes, the edge and the trail turn dashed and the tag reads 'Not written on the page'.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different source and the opposite direction — an entry whose wording is NOT on the page is replaced by the exact wording of ¶2, so it becomes a quotation: the highlight appears, the edge turns solid and the ¶ tab and the trail move to ¶2.
